title: Print a ledger header
summary: printf, format specifiers, and printing money from integer paise.
hints: `balance_paise / 100` is the rupees part (integer division throws away the remainder). `balance_paise % 100` is the paise part.
5 paise must print as `0.05`, not `0.5`. The format `%02lld` pads with zeros to at least two digits.
